categories.main_business_segments: LIFULL operates primarily in the 'HOME'S-related business,' which includes the real estate and housing information portal 'LIFULL HOME'S,' the investment property information site 'Kenbiya,' and related services. The company also has an 'Other' segment, which includes services such as the senior care facility search site 'LIFULL Kaigo' and regional revitalization projects. As of FY2025, overseas businesses have been classified as discontinued operations, making the domestic HOME'S-related business the sole reportable segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: LIFULL's core technologies center on internet-based information platforms, leveraging AI and generative AI for data aggregation, property performance evaluation, and user experience optimization. The company utilizes big data analytics, recommendation engines, and machine learning to enhance search functionality and automate processes such as property freshness and fraud detection. Continuous investment in proprietary software development and patented tools (e.g., maintenance visualization) underpins its service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's main customers are real estate agencies, property owners, investors, and end-users seeking residential or investment properties. LIFULL also serves elderly individuals and their families through its senior care facility search services, as well as local governments and organizations involved in regional revitalization. The primary markets are the Japanese real estate and housing sectors, with a focus on both B2B (real estate professionals) and B2C (general consumers) segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: LIFULL's operations are now focused almost exclusively on Japan, following the divestiture of its overseas segment in FY2025. The company maintains offices in major Japanese cities such as Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka, and Sapporo. While it previously had a global presence, current activities and revenue are overwhelmingly domestic, with only minor sales in Asia (e.g., Vietnam, Malaysia) through technology subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: LIFULL operates downstream in the value chain, acting as an information intermediary and digital platform provider that connects property seekers with real estate agencies and property owners. It does not own or develop properties but facilitates transactions and information flow between supply (real estate professionals) and demand (consumers/investors).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the core HOME'S platform, expanding group synergies, and driving digital transformation in the real estate sector through advanced AI and data technologies. The company is focused on social impact themes such as housing accessibility, regional revitalization, and aging society solutions. R&D efforts are concentrated on AI-driven search, user experience innovation, and new business creation, with a dedicated AI organization and active internal innovation programs.
categories.revenue_model: LIFULL generates revenue primarily through subscription and listing fees from real estate agencies for property postings, as well as performance-based fees for successful user inquiries or leads. Additional revenue streams include advertising, information services for senior care facilities, and regional revitalization consulting. The company also earns rental income from investment properties and offers ancillary services such as financial products and local investment funds.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other real estate information portals such as SUUMO (Recruit), At Home, and Yahoo! Real Estate. LIFULL positions itself as a leading digital platform in the Japanese real estate information market, emphasizing technological innovation and social value. The company faces intense competition in both the property listing and senior care information segments, but differentiates itself through AI-driven features and a strong focus on social issues.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2025, LIFULL reported consolidated revenue of 28.1 billion yen (+6.9% YoY), operating profit of 3.8 billion yen (+26.1% YoY), and net profit attributable to owners of 5.3 billion yen (recovering from a prior year loss). The company has over 900 employees and total assets of approximately 41 billion yen. After restructuring and focusing on domestic operations, profitability and cash flow have improved, with a stable growth outlook in its core segment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: LIFULL emphasizes a unique value proposition of using advanced AI and comprehensive data to deliver highly personalized, transparent, and efficient property search experiences. The company positions itself as a social innovator, addressing housing accessibility, regional revitalization, and aging society challenges. Differentiation is achieved through proprietary technology, a broad service ecosystem, and a strong commitment to social impact and user trust.
